description: Add WYSIWYG HTML editing to your WinForms application, with Word paste, spell checking and HTML source editing. Supports .NET 10 and .NET Framework 4.5+.
releaseNotes: Add Custom interface language selection with EditorStrings.custom.json. Complete custom translations no longer replace a built-in English translation. Built-in culture overrides stay separate; missing custom keys fall back to neutral English. Existing language enum values remain unchanged.
title: SpiceLogic .NET WinForms HTML Editor Control
